title: Jammy Brazilian Doenjang Leaf Wrap
description: A jammy, silky, nostalgic Brazilian dish featuring doenjang, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, served in an iron teppan.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat.
Mix doenjang, brown sugar, water, garlic, and ginger in a bowl until smooth.
Brush the coconut oil onto the collard green leaves.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the doenjang mixture onto the center of each leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight package.
Place the leaf packages seam-side down onto the preheated teppan.
Cover the teppan with a lid and steam the leaf wraps for 10 minutes.
Serve the jammy Brazilian doenjang leaf wraps hot, garnished with salt to taste.
